title: Where Polanyi Meets Galois: Tacit Knowing as an Algebro-Deterministic Operation, Toward Re-rooting AI-Generated Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.16102v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We argue that tacit knowing is better modelled as an operating regime of one memory substrate than as a kind of content. The substrate is VaCoAl, an algebro-deterministic XOR-and-shift hyperdimensional memory over GF(2), realized as CASRAM (commercial SRAM-CAM) and PyVaCoAl (DRAM-CAM).In VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl a directed acyclic graph (DAG) reads two ways. Repairing every collision (Rescue mode) makes the trace exactly auditable but ranks no path higher; tolerating collisions (Don't Care mode) yields a path-integrated confidence, CR$_2$, that silently favours direct routes. This audit-valuation complementarity is a formal counterpart of Polanyi's claim that tacit and explicit knowledge are not sharply divided. It separates contingent tacitness, which a new query brings out (AlphaGo's game tree), from regime-bound tacitness, statable only in a regime where it is gone (AlphaGo's hunches). (1) Polanyi's from-to structure reads as non-commutative

translated_title: 当波兰尼遇见伽罗瓦：作为代数确定性运算的默会认识——迈向AI生成科学的再扎根
translated_abstract: 我们论证，默会认识最好被建模为某一记忆基底的一种运行状态，而非一种内容类型。该基底是VaCoAl，一种定义在GF(2)上的代数确定性“异或-移位”超维记忆，其实现为CASRAM（商用SRAM-CAM）和PyVaCoAl（DRAM-CAM）。在VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl中，有向无环图（DAG）存在两种读取方式。修复每一次碰撞（Rescue模式）使轨迹完全可审计，但不会给任何路径赋予更高的排序；而容忍碰撞（Don't Care模式）则产生路径积分置信度CR₂，它会悄然偏向直接路径。这种审计-估值互补性是波兰尼关于默会知识与显性知识并非截然二分这一论断的形式化对应物。它区分了偶发性默会性——由新的查询所唤起（如AlphaGo的博弈树）——与状态约束性默会性——只能在它已然消失的状态中被陈述（如AlphaGo的直觉）。（1）波兰尼的“from-to”结构可读作非交换性……
tldr: 该论文将波兰尼的默会认识建模为GF(2)上代数确定性异或-移位超维记忆（VaCoAl）的一种运行状态，其“救援模式”与“不关心模式”之间的审计-估值互补性为默会知识与显性知识的连续统提供了形式化对应，从而为AI生成的科学重新扎根。
en_tdlr: The paper models Polanyi's tacit knowing as an operating regime of an algebro-deterministic XOR-and-shift hyperdimensional memory over GF(2) (VaCoAl), where the audit-valuation complementarity between Rescue mode and Don't Care mode formally grounds the tacit-explicit continuum toward re-rooting AI-generated science.
